text: Automatically classifies and labels incoming emails as they arrive
quote: Superhuman Mail automatically classifies incoming messages — so you can focus on what matters most.

text: Auto Archive automatically archives marketing, cold pitches, and social updates
quote: Superhuman AI can automatically archive marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates. Turn on Auto Archive, and eliminate inbox clutter for good.

text: Every email needing a reply gets an auto-generated draft you can edit and send
quote: Every email that needs a reply comes with a draft—you can just edit and send.

text: Automatically reminds you to follow up on unanswered emails, with a ready-made draft
quote: If your email needs a response, you’re automatically reminded to follow up—with a draft already written and ready to send.

text: Find Time feature instantly shows when teammates are free for scheduling
quote: Simply add teammates, click "Find Time", and instantly see when everyone is free.

text: Cmd+K opens a command palette to instantly perform any action and learn shortcuts
quote: Cmd+K brings up Superhuman Command, where you can instantly do any action — and also learn the shortcut for next time.

text: Plain-language instructions (e.g. 'write in lowercase') personalize AI writing and scheduling behavior
quote: Add plain-language instructions like "write in lowercase" or "use this booking link" to personalize your writing and scheduling features.

text: MCP server connects inbox and calendar to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants for summarizing, drafting, and scheduling
quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.

text: Claude or ChatGPT can be connected directly to read, draft, and send emails via a single prompt
quote: Connect Claude or ChatGPT directly to your inbox to read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt — no copy-pasting required.

text: Instantly switch between connected Outlook and Gmail accounts without switching apps
quote: you can instantly switch between Outlook and Gmail accounts without switching apps.

text: Works fully offline, syncing when reconnected, even with poor internet
quote: Superhuman gives you a new way to work with Gmail. It works perfectly offline.

text: Auto Labels automatically separate marketing, cold pitches, and social updates into categories
quote: Superhuman AI will automatically separate marketing, cold pitches, and social network updates, so you can respond faster to what matters most.

text: Custom Auto Labels can be created using short AI prompts (e.g. 'job applications')
quote: You can even make your own Auto Labels with short AI prompts like "job applications" or "requests to review work".

text: Lets you focus on one topic at a time by grouping same-type emails together
quote: you can focus on a specific topic — and get through emails of the same type, at the same time.

text: Natural-language questions about the inbox/calendar (e.g. 'when is my flight') return direct answers
quote: Just ask: _"where is the q2 offsite"_, _"when is my flight"_, _"where am I staying"_, and we'll immediately generate succinct answers.

text: Can add and toggle multiple Gmail and Outlook calendars within the app
quote: You can add all your Gmail and Outlook account calendars, and easily toggle them on and off.

text: Connects all Gmail and Outlook accounts (work, personal, side projects) into one AI assistant
quote: Connect all your Gmail and Outlook accounts, including work, personal, and side projects. Manage every inbox and calendar from one AI assistant, without complicated workarounds.

text: One prompt can check read status, draft all follow-up nudges, and send at optimal times
quote: Handle every follow-up with one prompt. Superhuman Mail can check which emails have been read, draft all the nudges, and send when each recipient is most likely to open it.

text: Users can design custom inbox categories like VIP, Notifications, Calendar, or Team
quote: in Superhuman Mail, you can design your own categories: like "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar", or "Team".

text: Drafts are written to match the user's own voice and tone
quote: Every message that needs a reply comes with a draft written in your voice.

text: Auto Drafts pull context from inbox, calendar, and the web, including inserting availability and doing research
quote: Auto Drafts now gather context from your inbox, your calendar, and the web. They can use information from other emails, insert availability, and conduct research online.

text: When an email mentions a date, a side panel shows your day for context
quote: When any email mentions a date, Superhuman Mail will show your day in the right side panel — so you always have context.

text: Every automated send action requires explicit user approval before sending
quote: Every send action requires your explicit approval, so you stay in control.

text: Supports adding a secondary time zone to simplify cross-timezone scheduling
quote: Working across time zones? Add a secondary time zone, so scheduling between San Francisco and New York (or London and Tokyo) is effortless.

text: Insert commonly-used phrases, paragraphs, or full emails via a keyboard shortcut (Snippets)
quote: Insert commonly-used phrases, paragraphs, or whole emails with a simple keyboard shortcut.

text: Snippets can be shared across a team for consistent messaging
quote: You can also share Snippets with your team, so your team can move faster, with consistent, up-to-date, and high-performing messaging.

text: Team Read Statuses share read receipts across the team so anyone can follow up with context
quote: Team Read Statuses: Read statuses are now shared across your team, so anybody can follow up with full context.

text: Team Reply Indicators show when a teammate is replying to avoid duplicate responses
quote: Team Reply Indicators: See when your team is replying, so you can avoid double work and embarrassing collisions.

text: Team Scheduling shows when teammates are free for fast scheduling
quote: Team Scheduling: See when your team is free, so you can schedule at the speed of thought.

text: Lets teammates @mention each other and share live email views to coordinate without external visibility
quote: let you @mention teammates, share live email views, and coordinate responses without external recipients seeing internal discussions

text: Agents can be built via chat or visual builder to run proactively based on set triggers
quote: Use chat or our visual builder to create agents that run proactively based on triggers you set and the work you connect.

text: Admins can govern who builds agents and control connector permissions org-wide
quote: Admins govern who can build agents and control connector permissions across the entire org from one place.

text: Claude/ChatGPT can drive Superhuman Mail to run workflows across inbox and calendar
quote: You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools. You can create powerful workflows that run across your inbox and calendar

text: Short jotted phrases can be turned into a full email written in the user's voice
quote: Just jot down some phrases, and we'll turn them into a full email. Best of all, the email sounds like you. Superhuman AI matches the voice and tone in the emails you've already sent
